passage:
In music class, students learned a protest song from decades ago. The melody was simple, but the words were strong.
The teacher explained the historical situation that gave the song meaning. People had sung it during marches, meetings, and difficult times.
Students first sang it softly. After understanding the story, they sang with more feeling.
They discussed whether songs can change society. The teacher said a song alone may not change laws, but it can give people courage and unity.
The song showed that music can carry more than entertainment. It can carry memory, anger, hope, and collective strength across generations.
